neighbours.label: ' w' as the start of 'wobble' / 'wobbling' (predicting a wobbling motion)
fire: The old washing machine began to wobble during the spin cycle.
If the table legs are uneven, the whole table will wobble.
Put a folded napkin under one leg to stop the table wobbling.
The ceiling fan started wobbling after we changed the blades.
Astronomers measured the wobble of the star to find its hidden planet.
At high speed the car's steering wheel began to wobble.
As the coin slowed down on the counter, it started to wobble.
The new shelf would wobble every time someone closed the door.
quiet: The old washing machine began to leak during the spin cycle.
If the table legs are uneven, the whole table will look crooked.
Put a folded napkin under the plate to stop the table getting stained.
The ceiling fan started squeaking after we changed the blades.
Astronomers measured the brightness of the star to find its hidden planet.
At high speed the car's engine began to roar.
As the coin rolled across the counter, it dropped onto the floor.
The new shelf would creak every time someone closed the door.

notes: Probe: wobble and wobbling peaked on ' w' at 0.42-1.08. 'wobbly' only reached 0.23. Related motion contexts without the word (precession 0.35, pendulum 0.31, a top falling over 0.28) were moderate, so quiet items keep the mechanical topic but use a non-oscillation verb.
